object.script:
function round(num, n) return math.floor(num * 10^n + 0.5) / 10^n end
function floor(n) return n >= 0 and n - n % 1 or n - n % 1 - 1 end
function onTick() cs = input.getNumber(1) speed = input.getNumber(2) alt = input.getNumber(3) bottom_dist = input.getNumber(4) axisX = input.getNumber(5) axisY = input.getNumber(6) dh = input.getNumber(7)
-- == Compass == compass_y = 4 compass_x1 = 7 compass_x2 = 93 compass_w = compass_x2 - compass_x1 x = compass_x1 + (1 - cs) * compass_w
-- == Speed == speed_max_fwd = 16 speed_max_rev = -3
speedY_risk = 0 speedY_text = 0
if speed >= 0 then if speed <= speed_max_fwd then speedY = 79 - (speed / speed_max_fwd) * 66 else speedY = 16 end else if speed >= speed_max_rev then speedY = 79 - (speed / speed_max_rev) * 66 else speedY = 16 end end
speedY_risk = math.max(17, math.min(79, speedY)) speedY_text = math.max(17, math.min(75, speedY))
-- == Alt == if alt >= 0 then depth = 0.1 depthY = 16 else depth = -alt bottom_depth = depth + bottom_dist depthY = 16 + (depth / bottom_depth) * 66 if depthY > 82 - 2 then depthY = 82 - 2 end if depthY < 16 then depthY = 16 end end end
function onDraw() screen.setColor(32, 32, 32) screen.drawText(0,32,"1") screen.drawText(0,48,"2") screen.drawText(0,64,"3") screen.drawRectF(0, 0, 5, 24) screen.drawRectF(0, 76, 5, 24)
screen.setColor(96, 96, 96) screen.drawRect(5, 0, 90, 95)
local s = screen local sc = s.setColor local dl = s.drawLine local dt = s.drawText
-- == Compass == sc(0, 127, 255) dl(7, compass_y, 93, compass_y)
sc(255, 0, 0) dl(x, compass_y - 2, x, compass_y + 2)
sc(255, 255, 255) local dir = floor(cs * 360) % 360 local t = tostring(dir) local tx = 50 - (#t * 3) dt(tx + 1, compass_y + 4, t)
-- == Speed == sc(0, 127, 255) dl(7, 16, 7, 80) dl(7, 16, 9, 16) dl(7, 80, 9, 80) sc(255,255,255) dt(7, 10, "SPD")
if speed >= 0 then sc(speed <= speed_max_fwd and 0 or 255, speed <= speed_max_fwd and 255 or 0, 0) else sc(speed >= speed_max_rev and 0 or 255, speed >= speed_max_rev and 255 or 0, 0) end dl(7, speedY_risk, 10, speedY_risk) dt(11, speedY_text, round(speed, 1))
-- == Alt == sc(0, 127, 255) dl(93, 16, 93, 80) dl(92, 16, 93, 16) dl(92, 80, 94, 80) sc(255, 255, 255) dt(81, 10, "ALT")
if alt < 0 then sc(255, 0, 0) dl(91, depthY, 94, depthY) if depth >= 100 then dt(81, depthY-3, string.format("%d", floor(depth))) else dt(86, depthY-3, string.format("%d", floor(depth))) end end
-- == Bottom Text == sc(255,255,255) if depth >= 100 then dt(25, 82 + 1, string.format("Bottom: %d", floor(bottom_dist+depth))) dt(25, 80 + 7, string.format("DH: %d", floor(-dh))) else dt(30, 82, string.format("Bottom: %d", floor(bottom_dist+depth))) dt(30, 88, string.format("DH: %d", floor(-dh))) end end
